classification: Each control is assigned from its ISM section title. Patching controls are split by the subject of the statement (applications and online services, or operating systems, drivers and firmware). Office macro statements stay with restrict_office_macros. Incident-reporting controls that the ISM does not place under one mitigation strategy are listed in unassigned_control_ids and are not copied onto every strategy.
